rules.v: Recruiters must be licensed and can be sanctioned, but are not jointly liable for the employer's obligations
rules.vi: Perekrut wajib berizin dan dapat dikenai sanksi, tetapi tidak bertanggung jawab bersama atas kewajiban majikan
rules.n: Recruiting agents need a licence and a security deposit and may be sanctioned; the Act and the 2019 Rules regulate sub-agents, but agents are not made jointly liable for the employer's obligations.

rules.fi: Biaya rekrutmen yang dibebankan kepada pekerja
rules.v: Fees are capped by law, or prohibited only for listed occupations or destinations
rules.vi: Biaya dibatasi oleh hukum, atau dilarang hanya untuk jabatan atau negara tujuan tertentu
rules.n: The government sets a maximum migration cost for each destination (for example for Saudi Arabia and Malaysia); charging more is an offense.

rules.v: A written contract with minimum terms set or verified by the state is required for every worker before departure
rules.vi: Kontrak tertulis dengan syarat minimum yang ditetapkan atau diverifikasi negara wajib bagi setiap pekerja sebelum berangkat
rules.n: Emigration clearance requires an employment contract with stated terms, attested by the mission where required.

rules.v: Orientation is compulsory but may be charged to the worker, or compulsory only for some categories
rules.vi: Orientasi wajib tetapi dapat dibebankan kepada pekerja, atau wajib hanya untuk sebagian kategori
rules.n: Pre-departure briefing is required for clearance; longer training is required for women going into domestic work; whether all of it is free to the worker is not established.

rules.v: A statutory fund or compulsory insurance covers all registered workers for death, disability and repatriation, and funds legal or welfare assistance abroad
rules.vi: Dana berdasarkan undang-undang atau asuransi wajib mencakup semua pekerja terdaftar untuk kematian, cacat dan pemulangan, serta membiayai bantuan hukum atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
rules.n: The Wage Earners' Welfare Fund, financed by compulsory contributions, pays death and disability benefits, repatriation of bodies and legal assistance.

rules.fi: Atase tenaga kerja atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
rules.v: A statute requires labor or welfare officers in missions in the main destination countries
rules.vi: Undang-undang mewajibkan atase tenaga kerja atau kesejahteraan di perwakilan negara tujuan utama
rules.n: The Act provides for labor welfare wings in missions in destination countries.

rules.v: A specialized body at home can award compensation to workers against recruiters (and employers abroad) for breaches during recruitment or employment
rules.vi: Badan khusus di dalam negeri dapat memberi ganti rugi kepada pekerja terhadap perekrut (dan majikan asing) atas pelanggaran selama rekrutmen atau kerja
rules.n: A worker may complain to the government, which may settle the matter by arbitration and order compensation; offenses can also be prosecuted.

rules.f: Exit without sex- or age-specific restrictions
rules.fi: Keberangkatan tanpa pembatasan khusus jenis kelamin atau usia
rules.v: Restrictions whose terms apply to women only (higher minimum ages, consent requirements, bans)
rules.vi: Pembatasan yang secara tertulis hanya berlaku bagi perempuan (usia minimum lebih tinggi, syarat izin, larangan)
rules.n: Women going abroad for domestic work must be at least 25 (with an upper age limit in some recruitment rounds); the rule applies to women only. Current wording to be confirmed with BMET.
rules.s: BMET guidelines; Daily Star and Financial Express reports

rules.v: A statute assigns a public body the duty to provide reintegration services (employment, financial, psychosocial) to returning workers
rules.vi: Undang-undang memberi badan publik kewajiban menyediakan layanan reintegrasi (kerja, keuangan, psikososial) bagi pekerja yang pulang
rules.n: The Wage Earners' Welfare Board has statutory functions on rehabilitation and reintegration; Probashi Kallyan Bank provides reintegration loans.
rules.s: Wage Earners' Welfare Board Act 2018; OEMP 2016

rules.f: Shelter for workers in distress abroad
rules.fi: Tempat penampungan bagi pekerja bermasalah di luar negeri
rules.v: Shelters or safe houses are run at some missions by policy or practice
rules.vi: Tempat penampungan dikelola di sebagian perwakilan berdasarkan kebijakan atau praktik
rules.n: Safe homes for women workers are run at some missions by policy.

rules.v: An official line exists but not around the clock, or only at some missions
rules.vi: Saluran resmi ada tetapi tidak 24 jam, atau hanya di sebagian perwakilan
rules.n: Official helplines for migrants exist; round-the-clock operation is not confirmed.

rules.v: A statute provides or funds legal assistance for workers abroad, including in criminal and civil proceedings
rules.vi: Undang-undang menyediakan atau membiayai bantuan hukum bagi pekerja di luar negeri, termasuk dalam perkara pidana dan perdata
rules.n: The Wage Earners' Welfare Fund may be used for legal aid to migrant workers abroad.

rules.v: Gender-specific measures rest on policy or programs
rules.vi: Langkah khusus gender bertumpu pada kebijakan atau program
rules.n: The 2016 Policy has measures for women migrant workers, including safe homes and complaint desks; the 2013 Act has no specific provision on violence.

rules.fi: Kematian di luar negeri: pemulangan dan pemeriksaan
rules.v: Repatriation and a death benefit are provided, without a route to establish the cause of death
rules.vi: Pemulangan dan santunan kematian diberikan, tanpa jalur untuk memastikan sebab kematian
rules.n: The Welfare Board pays burial costs (Tk 35,000) and compensation and receives remains; post-mortem examination on arrival is rare.

rules.fi: UU antiperdagangan orang yang mencakup kerja
rules.v: A dedicated statute criminalizes trafficking for forced labor and provides victim assistance, protection or restitution
rules.vi: UU khusus memidanakan perdagangan orang untuk kerja paksa dan menyediakan bantuan, pelindungan atau restitusi bagi korban
rules.n: Dedicated Act with special tribunals and victim protection and rehabilitation.
rules.s: Prevention and Suppression of Human Trafficking Act 2012

decisions.nm: Md. Sadaqat Khan (Fakku) v. Chief Election Commissioner
decisions.ct: High Court Division, Supreme Court of Bangladesh
decisions.pe: Urdu-speaking people who stayed in Bangladesh after 1971 lived for decades in camps without recognition as citizens. The High Court said they are citizens and must be allowed to vote.
decisions.pi: Warga berbahasa Urdu yang tetap tinggal di Bangladesh setelah 1971 hidup puluhan tahun di kamp tanpa diakui sebagai warga negara. Pengadilan Tinggi menyatakan mereka warga negara dan berhak memilih.

decisions.nm: Writ on Bangladeshi workers who died on World Cup projects
decisions.ct: High Court Division, Supreme Court of Bangladesh
decisions.pe: A lawyer asked Bangladesh’s High Court to make the government account for workers who died or were hurt building stadiums abroad. The court ordered a list and asked about compensation. A higher judge paused part of the order.
decisions.pi: Seorang advokat meminta Pengadilan Tinggi Bangladesh mewajibkan pemerintah mendata pekerja yang meninggal atau cedera saat membangun stadion di luar negeri. Pengadilan memerintahkan pendataan dan menanyakan ganti rugi. Hakim yang lebih tinggi menangguhkan sebagian perintah itu.

decisions.nm: Abid Khan v. Government of Bangladesh
decisions.ct: High Court Division, Supreme Court of Bangladesh

help.de: Organization of returnee migrant workers. Legal help, airport pickup, counseling and shelter for returnees and survivors of trafficking.
help.di: Organisasi mantan pekerja migran. Bantuan hukum, penjemputan di bandara, konseling dan rumah aman bagi pekerja yang pulang dan korban perdagangan orang.

help.de: Free 24-hour government hotline for Bangladeshi migrant workers and their families, run by the Wage Earners' Welfare Board. Covers legal problems abroad, compensation and bringing home the body of a worker who died.
help.di: Saluran pemerintah gratis 24 jam bagi pekerja migran Bangladesh dan keluarganya, dikelola Wage Earners' Welfare Board. Menangani masalah hukum di luar negeri, kompensasi dan pemulangan jenazah.
